LLaDA-Image.name: LLaDA-Image
LLaDA-Image.description: LLaDA-Image 6B text-to-image and instruction-guided editing. Denoiser is a Lumina2/Z-Image-style NextDiT conditioned by a LLaDA2-MoE diffusion-LLM text encoder, reusing the Flux.2 VAE. Requires a transformer, text encoder, VAE, and an embeddings_connectors file (QueryFormer + text_projection, plus SigVQ image encoder for editing). Two checkpoints ship: this base (50 steps) and Turbo (4 steps, its own card) - each with its own transformer + text encoder + connectors, only VAE and tokenizer are shared. Added upstream via leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp#1968.

requiredComponents.tokenizer: LLaDA2 tokenizer.json (same file for base + Turbo)
requiredComponents.embeddings_connectors: llada-image-connectors-edit.safetensors (the -edit file also carries the SigVQ encoder that image editing needs; the plain file is text-to-image only)
